tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: AME of CMG station across Mahadayi River by Bank operated cable way at Chapoli Tq Khanapur for the year 2026-27

itemList.description: Clearing grass and removal of Rubbish and dumping to outside periphery by manual means complete with all lead and lifts.

Providing and applying grease of approved quality to gate and hoist components requiring greasing as part of the annual maintenance using grease gun where ever necessary including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, scaffolding with all other ancillary operations complete with all lead and lifts.

Engauging Literate Assistant / Gauge reader for observing and taking reading twice a day i.e., between 8 AM to 12 PM & 2 PM to 6 PM by using Standard / Pigmy current meters as per the depth of water in the river. The river is divided in to several compartment at average 2/1m intervals. Totally he has to observe and take 75/60 readings and enter all readings in the register supplied to him, by properly connecting current meters to counter and wadding rods etc. When depth of flow in the river is more than 0.6m he has to use Standard current meter with help of trolley, conducting above said procedures and recording the readings in the register twice a day.

Engauging Heavy Mazdoor (Un -Skilled) to carrying the gauging materials, such as Standard /Pigmy current meters and wading rods/ fish weight/ wire rope and other required accessories to the gauging site, and helping the literate assistant in fixing the wire rope on both ends of the river banks till gauging is completed, firmly controlling, connecting and holding revolution counter and wires and keeping the wires above surface of water, removing and diverting rooted bushes and snakes crabs etc. in the river and taking precautionary measures, and barring the entry of the people entering the river during gauging etc., After conducting the gauging work bringing all materials to the site store as directed by gauge reader or site in charge.
